brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.evidence: 4 base cells: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full
requirements.requirement: Tray of at least four cells

requirements.evidence: 4x bin hex-bin-full-drain (bin:0,0,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:1,0,0, bin:1,-1,0), one per cell
requirements.requirement: Each cell with a draining bin

requirements.evidence: soil filled in all 4 bins + seedling plugs (basil, romaine, chives, parsley); check_build ok, meshClash clear, look from above sees all 4 plants

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell tray with a full-depth drained bin in each cell, filled with soil and planted with seedlings. House rules applied (capOpenFaces + lockJoints), check_build clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
